Claude Code and Cursor have built-in plugin marketplaces. OpenCode uses a plugin array in &#96;opencode.json&#96;. Codex and Gemini CLI have their own install mechanisms.\n\n## Claude Code (Official)\n\nSuperpowers is available on the official Claude plugin marketplace. Run this command in Claude Code:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis is the recommended install path for Claude Code users.\n\n## Claude Code (Marketplace)\n\nIf you prefer to install from the community marketplace, register it first, then install Superpowers:\n\n## Register the marketplace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Install the plugin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Cursor\n\nIn Cursor's agent chat, run:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n/add-plugin superpowers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAlternatively, search for \"superpowers\" in the Cursor plugin marketplace and install from there.\n\n## OpenCode\n\nAdd Superpowers to the &#96;plugin&#96; array in your &#96;opencode.json&#96;. This can be your global config (&#96;~/.config/opencode/opencode.json&#96;) or a project-level file.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"plugin\": [\"superpowers@git+https://github.com/obra/superpowers.git\"]\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nRestart OpenCode. The plugin auto-installs via Bun and registers all skills automatically.\n\nTo pin a specific version, append the tag: &#96;superpowers@git+https://github.com/obra/superpowers.git#v5.0.3&#96;\n\nMigrating from the old symlink-based install\n\nIf you previously installed Superpowers using &#96;git clone&#96; and symlinks, remove the old setup first:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nrm -f ~/.config/opencode/plugins/superpowers.js\nrm -rf ~/.config/opencode/skills/superpowers\nrm -rf ~/.config/opencode/superpowers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAlso remove any &#96;skills.paths&#96; entry in your &#96;opencode.json&#96; that pointed to the old clone, then follow the install steps above.\n\n## Codex\n\nTell Codex:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\nFetch and follow instructions from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obra/superpowers/refs/heads/main/.codex/INSTALL.md\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCodex will clone the repository and create the required symlink in &#96;~/.agents/skills/superpowers&#96;. [Superpowers：为AI编程智能体赋予工程化超能力（安装与配置）](https://juejin.cn/post/7621026569314598938)\n\nSuperpowers 是一个为 AI 编程代理(Coding Agents)设计的软件开发工作流框架,通过一系列可组合的“技能”(Skills)来引导 AI 进行头脑风暴、规划、测试驱动开发(TDD)、调试和代码审查等。\n\n### 在 Cursor 中安装 Superpowers 的方式\n\n目前主要有以下几种安装方式:\n\n#### 1. 通过 Cursor 插件市场安装(推荐)\n这是最简单且官方推荐的方式。\n*   在 Cursor 的 Agent 对话框中,输入以下命令:\n    &#96;/add-plugin superpowers&#96;\n*   或者在 Cursor 的插件市场中直接搜索 \"superpowers\" 进行安装。\n\n#### 2. 手动克隆仓库安装\n如果你需要更细粒度的控制,可以手动克隆仓库:\n*   **创建目录**:\n    &#96;mkdir -p ~/.cursor/skills&#96;\n*   **克隆仓库**:\n    &#96;git clone https://github.com/obra/superpowers.git ~/.cursor/skills/superpowers&#96;\n\n#### 3. 使用中文增强版(superpowers-zh)\n如果你需要中文支持或针对国内开发环境的优化,可以使用 &#96;superpowers-zh&#96;:\n*   **使用 npm 安装**:\n    在你的项目目录下运行:\n    &#96;npx superpowers-zh&#96;\n    该命令会自动检测你的工具并安装到正确位置。\n\n### 技能目录与配置\n*   **技能存放位置**:安装后,技能通常位于 &#96;~/.cursor/skills/superpowers/skills/&#96; 目录下。\n*   **配置引导**:为了确保 Cursor 能够正确调用这些技能,建议在 &#96;~/.cursor/rules/&#96; 目录下创建一个引导规则文件(如 &#96;superpowers-bootstrap.mdc&#96;),强制 AI 在执行任务前检查并读取相关的技能文件。\n\n### 验证安装\n安装完成后,重启 Cursor 或开启一个新的对话,询问 AI:\n**“do you have superpowers?”**\n如果安装成功,AI 会确认其已加载相关工作流并解释其功能。\n\n### 常见技能目录结构\n安装后的技能库通常包含以下核心模块:\n*   &#96;brainstorming&#96;:需求拆解与设计。\n*   &#96;test-driven-development&#96;:TDD 开发流程。\n*   &#96;systematic-debugging&#96;:系统化调试。\n*   &#96;writing-plans&#96;:编写实施计划。\n*   &#96;subagent-driven-development&#96;:子代理驱动开发。\n*   &#96;using-git-worktrees&#96;:Git 工作树管理。\n\n如需更新技能,只需进入对应的插件目录执行 &#96;git pull&#96; 即可。\n\nSources:\n- https://gitcode.csdn.net/69c09c3554b52172bc636d7c.html\n- https://gist.github.com/SOY4RIAS/b7acafb1e61827c17ecf755de008e8fd\n- https://github.com/obra/superpowers\n- https://www.michaelapp.com/posts/2026/2026-03-01-cursor-%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E5%92%8C%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8superpowers/\n- https://juejin.cn/post/7621026569314598938\n- https://www.mintlify.com/obra/superpowers/development/plugin-system\n- https://blog.gitcode.com/d7331845270f901fca14f4992d3abca5.html\n- https://forum.cursor.com/t/how-can-the-cursor-perfectly-support-superpowers-https-github-com-obra-superpowers/151285\n- https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/main/RELEASE-NOTES.md\n- https://github.com/jnMetaCode/superpowers-zh",

{
  "markdown": "# Superpowers\n\nSuperpowers is a complete software development workflow for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable \"skills\" and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.\n\n## How it works\n\nIt starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. \n\nOnce it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. \n\nAfter you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY. \n\nNext up, once you say \"go\", it launches a *subagent-driven-development* process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for Claude to be able to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.\n\nThere's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system. And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special. Your coding agent just has Superpowers.\n\n\n## Sponsorship\n\nIf Superpowers has helped you do stuff that makes money and you are so inclined, I'd greatly appreciate it if you'd consider [sponsoring my opensource work](https://github.com/sponsors/obra).\n\nThanks! \n\n- Jesse\n\n\n## Installation\n\n**Note:** Installation differs by platform. Claude Code or Cursor have built-in plugin marketplaces. Codex and OpenCode require manual setup.\n\n### Claude Code Official Marketplace\n\nSuperpowers is available via the [official Claude plugin marketplace](https://claude.com/plugins/superpowers)\n\nInstall the plugin from Claude marketplace:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Claude Code (via Plugin Marketplace)\n\nIn Claude Code, register the marketplace first:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen install the plugin from this marketplace:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Cursor (via Plugin Marketplace)\n\nIn Cursor Agent chat, install from marketplace:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n/add-plugin superpowers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nor search for \"superpowers\" in the plugin marketplace.\n\n### Codex\n\nTell Codex:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFetch and follow instructions from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obra/superpowers/refs/heads/main/.codex/INSTALL.md\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Detailed docs:** [docs/README.codex.md](docs/README.codex.md)\n\n### OpenCode\n\nTell OpenCode:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFetch and follow instructions from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obra/superpowers/refs/heads/main/.opencode/INSTALL.md\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Detailed docs:** [docs/README.opencode.md](docs/README.opencode.md)\n\n### GitHub Copilot CLI\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncopilot plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace\ncopilot plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Gemini CLI\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngemini extensions install https://github.com/obra/superpowers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nTo update:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngemini extensions update superpowers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verify Installation\n\nStart a new session in your chosen platform and ask for something that should trigger a skill (for example, \"help me plan this feature\" or \"let's debug this issue\"). The agent should automatically invoke the relevant superpowers skill.\n\n## The Basic Workflow\n\n1. **brainstorming** - Activates before writing code. Refines rough ideas through questions, explores alternatives, presents design in sections for validation. Saves design document.\n\n2. **using-git-worktrees** - Activates after design approval. Creates isolated workspace on new branch, runs project setup, verifies clean test baseline.\n\n3. **writing-plans** - Activates with approved design. Breaks work into bite-sized tasks (2-5 minutes each). Every task has exact file paths, complete code, verification steps.\n\n4. **subagent-driven-development** or **executing-plans** - Activates with plan. Dispatches fresh subagent per task with two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality), or executes in batches with human checkpoints.\n\n5. **test-driven-development** - Activates during implementation. Enforces RED-GREEN-REFACTOR: write failing test, watch it fail, write minimal code, watch it pass, commit. Deletes code written before tests.\n\n6. **requesting-code-review** - Activates between tasks. Reviews against plan, reports issues by severity. Critical issues block progress.\n\n7. **finishing-a-development-branch** - Activates when tasks complete. Verifies tests, presents options (merge/PR/keep/discard), cleans up worktree.\n\n**The agent checks for relevant skills before any task.** Mandatory workflows, not suggestions.\n\n## What's Inside\n\n### Skills Library\n\n**Testing**\n- **test-driven-development** - RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle (includes testing anti-patterns reference)\n\n**Debugging**\n- **systematic-debugging** - 4-phase root cause process (includes root-cause-tracing, defense-in-depth, condition-based-waiting techniques)\n- **verification-before-completion** - Ensure it's actually fixed\n\n**Collaboration** \n- **brainstorming** - Socratic design refinement\n- **writing-plans** - Detailed implementation plans\n- **executing-plans** - Batch execution with checkpoints\n- **dispatching-parallel-agents** - Concurrent subagent workflows\n- **requesting-code-review** - Pre-review checklist\n- **receiving-code-review** - Responding to feedback\n- **using-git-worktrees** - Parallel development branches\n- **finishing-a-development-branch** - Merge/PR decision workflow\n- **subagent-driven-development** - Fast iteration with two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality)\n\n**Meta**\n- **writing-skills** - Create new skills following best practices (includes testing methodology)\n- **using-superpowers** - Introduction to the skills system\n\n## Philosophy\n\n- **Test-Driven Development** - Write tests first, always\n- **Systematic over ad-hoc** - Process over guessing\n- **Complexity reduction** - Simplicity as primary goal\n- **Evidence over claims** - Verify before declaring success\n\nRead more: [Superpowers for Claude Code](https://blog.fsck.com/2025/10/09/superpowers/)\n\n## Contributing\n\nSkills live directly in this repository. To contribute:\n\n1. Fork the repository\n2. Create a branch for your skill\n3. Follow the &#96;writing-skills&#96; skill for creating and testing new skills\n4. Submit a PR\n\nSee &#96;skills/writing-skills/SKILL.md&#96; for the complete guide.\n\n## Updating\n\nSkills update automatically when you update the plugin:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n/plugin update superpowers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## License\n\nMIT License - see LICENSE file for details\n\n## Community\n\nSuperpowers is built by [Jesse Vincent](https://blog.fsck.com) and the rest of the folks at [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com).\n\n- **Discord**: [Join us](https://discord.gg/35wsABTejz) for community support, questions, and sharing what you're building with Superpowers\n- **Issues**: https://github.com/obra/superpowers/issues\n- **Release announcements**: [Sign up](https://primeradiant.com/superpowers/) to get notified about new versions\n",

{
  "markdown": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# SessionStart hook for superpowers plugin\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# Determine plugin root directory\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" \u0026\u0026 pwd)\"\nPLUGIN_ROOT=\"$(cd \"${SCRIPT_DIR}/..\" \u0026\u0026 pwd)\"\n\n# Check if legacy skills directory exists and build warning\nwarning_message=\"\"\nlegacy_skills_dir=\"${HOME}/.config/superpowers/skills\"\nif [ -d \"$legacy_skills_dir\" ]; then\n warning_message=\"\\n\\n IN YOUR FIRST REPLY AFTER SEEING THIS MESSAGE YOU MUST TELL THE USER:⚠️ **WARNING:** Superpowers now uses Claude Code's skills system. Custom skills in ~/.config/superpowers/skills will not be read. Move custom skills to ~/.claude/skills instead. To make this message go away, remove ~/.config/superpowers/skills \"\nfi\n\n# Read using-superpowers content\nusing_superpowers_content=$(cat \"${PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md\" 2\u003e\u00261 || echo \"Error reading using-superpowers skill\")\n\n# Escape string for JSON embedding using bash parameter substitution.\n# Each ${s//old/new} is a single C-level pass - orders of magnitude\n# faster than the character-by-character loop this replaces.\nescape_for_json() {\n local s=\"$1\"\n s=\"${s//\\\\/\\\\\\\\}\"\n s=\"${s//\\\"/\\\\\\\"}\"\n s=\"${s//$'\\n'/\\\\n}\"\n s=\"${s//$'\\r'/\\\\r}\"\n s=\"${s//$'\\t'/\\\\t}\"\n printf '%s' \"$s\"\n}\n\nusing_superpowers_escaped=$(escape_for_json \"$using_superpowers_content\")\nwarning_escaped=$(escape_for_json \"$warning_message\")\nsession_context=\" \\nYou have superpowers.\\n\\n**Below is the full content of your 'superpowers:using-superpowers' skill - your introduction to using skills. For all other skills, use the 'Skill' tool:**\\n\\n${using_superpowers_escaped}\\n\\n${warning_escaped}\\n \"\n\n# Output context injection as JSON.\n# Cursor hooks expect additional_context (snake_case).\n# Claude Code hooks expect hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (nested).\n# Copilot CLI (v1.0.11+) and others expect additionalContext (top-level, SDK standard).\n# Claude Code reads BOTH additional_context and hookSpecificOutput without\n# deduplication, so we must emit only the field the current platform consumes.\n#\n# Uses printf instead of heredoc to work around bash 5.3+ heredoc hang.\n# See: https://github.com/obra/superpowers/issues/571\nif [ -n \"${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}\" ]; then\n # Cursor sets CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT (may also set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT)\n printf '{\\n \"additional_context\": \"%s\"\\n}\\n' \"$session_context\"\nelif [ -n \"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}\" ] \u0026\u0026 [ -z \"${COPILOT_CLI:-}\" ]; then\n # Claude Code sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT without COPILOT_CLI\n printf '{\\n \"hookSpecificOutput\": {\\n \"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\",\\n \"additionalContext\": \"%s\"\\n }\\n}\\n' \"$session_context\"\nelse\n # Copilot CLI (sets COPILOT_CLI=1) or unknown platform — SDK standard format\n printf '{\\n \"additionalContext\": \"%s\"\\n}\\n' \"$session_context\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n",

说明当前已做的修正和官方用法如下。

## 已纠正的内容

1. **已删除**仓库里之前误加的「自编」`.cursor/skills/superpower/SKILL.md`，并去掉空的 `.cursor` 目录，**不再在项目里伪造 skill**。

2. **已安装真实的 [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) 技能库**到本机目录：  
   `~/.cursor/skills/superpowers/`  
   其下的 `skills/` 与官方仓库一致（如 `brainstorming`、`test-driven-development`、`systematic-debugging`、`using-superpowers` 等）。

   说明：你当前全局 Git 配置把 `https://github.com/` 重写成 `git@github.com:`，导致 `git clone` 走 SSH 失败。因此改用 **GitHub 上 `main` 分支的源码包**解压到上述路径，内容与官方仓库一致，但不是 git 克隆；若以后要 `git pull` 更新，需要先改掉该 `insteadOf` 规则，或定期重新下载 tarball。

## Cursor 上「正确」的 Superpowers 用法（官方）

- 在 **Cursor Agent 对话**里执行（官方文档写法）：  
  **`/add-plugin superpowers`**  
  或在插件市场里搜索 **superpowers** 安装。  
  这样会走官方 **`.cursor-plugin`**、**`hooks-cursor.json`** 和 **`session-start`**，在会话开始时注入 **`using-superpowers`** 等，这才是 Cursor 设计的集成方式。

你本机已有缓存目录  
`~/.cursor/plugins/cache/cursor-public/superpowers/...`（例如 5.0.5），说明插件可能曾经安装过；若 Agent 里技能未生效，请在 **Cursor 设置 → 插件 / Skills** 里确认 **Superpowers 已启用**，并新开一个 Agent 会话。

## 和 `/superpower` 的关系

官方安装命令是 **`/add-plugin superpowers`**（插件名是 **superpowers**），没有所谓「/superpower」这一条内置指令；若你看到 `/superpower`，多半是别的扩展或自定义命令，不是 obra 官方入口。

本地克隆的 `~/.cursor/skills/superpowers/skills/<技能名>/SKILL.md` 可与 Agent 的 **Read** 配合使用；在已安装并启用官方插件时，一般应优先走插件与 **Skill** 机制，避免和 hook 重复堆同一套说明。
